summary: Reviewed five candidates independently as of 2026-08-29. Approved only Harvey Nichols: completion and current owner are directly supported by Frasers/RNS and administrator evidence. Rejected eMAG, Trust, and InPost because the evidence confirms approval/announcement/offer status rather than completed transfer of control by the review date. Rejected HUGO BOSS because Frasers' 47.89% holding is not a majority/control acquisition and HUGO BOSS remains a listed company with Frasers described only as single largest shareholder.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Frasers Group acquired Harvey Nichols' UK stores, online business, inventory and international franchise rights through a pre-pack administration asset deal completed on 2026-08-13.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: The transaction was not a clean share acquisition of all historic Harvey Nichols companies. FTI Consulting states that immediately after the administrators were appointed on 2026-08-13, certain business operations and assets of Harvey Nichols Group entities were sold to Frasers Group Trading Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Frasers Group plc. The acquired assets include the UK store network, e-commerce platform and international franchise rights; the OXO Tower restaurant was sold separately to Fallow Media Limited.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing European luxury department-store brand. Completion is explicitly confirmed by both Frasers' RNS announcement and the administrators' FAQ, and the direct/ultimate ownership chain is supported by the administrator statement that Frasers Group Trading Limited is wholly owned by Frasers Group plc.

sources.publisher: Frasers Group plc via RNS / Investegate
sources.title: Frasers Group Acquisition of Harvey Nichols
sources.summary: Frasers Group plc announced on 2026-08-13 that it had acquired Harvey Nichols from FTI Consulting LLP, including six UK stores, the online business, inventory, employees, international franchise agreements and certain Dublin assets, excluding the OXO restaurant.

sources.title: Harvey Nichols and Company Limited | Creditors Portal UK
sources.summary: Administrator FAQ states that, immediately following the appointment of joint administrators on 2026-08-13, a sale of certain Harvey Nichols business operations and assets was completed to Frasers Group Trading Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Frasers Group plc; it separately identifies Fallow Media Limited as buyer of the OXO Tower restaurant assets.

rejected_candidates.reason: Reject: EU materials confirm notification and Commission compatibility decision for Naspers / eMAG dated 2026-08-06, but the candidate itself is pending_regulatory_review and no source found explicitly confirms the share transfer/completion had occurred by 2026-08-29. Approval is not completion.

Reject: ACCO Brands' 2026-08-14 release states it entered a definitive agreement to acquire Trust and that closing was expected in late Q3 or early Q4 2026 subject to customary conditions and competition approvals. No completed acquisition source was found by 2026-08-29.

Reject: sources confirm a conditional recommended public offer and EU clearance, not completed settlement/transfer of control. InPost's own FAQ still described the transaction as expected to complete in H2 2026, and reporting indicated at least one regulatory review remained pending after EU clearance.

Reject: Frasers' tender offer result gave it approximately 47.89% of share capital and voting rights, below a majority. HUGO BOSS' own release describes Frasers as the single largest shareholder and emphasizes continued established governance, not a completed control acquisition.
